narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Different solids must give different projections, or we could not tell them apart.
<bookmark mark='tall'/>Watch the cone grow taller. Its circle on the floor stays exactly the same.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Light from above cannot see height, so different solids can share one outline.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows different solids, different projections; the cone grows taller and its circle does not change; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>A projection keeps the outline seen from above and forgets how tall a solid is.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A cube of side five centimetres casts a square. Name two other solids that cast the same square.
